crop.notes: The 'Local Gossip' column of quoted opinions from many people; only the Tommy Murphy item mentions Allen. The column continues in the next page column, which is not needed for Allen.

ocr.notes: Readable with scattered errors; the Tommy Murphy item is accurate.

title.suggested: Tommy Murphy recalls the second Allen-McCoole fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat quoted Tommy Murphy, who said the ring was now run for money, and that the second Allen-McCoole fight had more fighting in one round than the 64 rounds of the Myer-McAuliffe fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, February 17, 1889, page 6.

notes: Allen appears only as a remembered fighter in one man's comment; no new facts.
